content: Acute risks are the harmful effects of drinking too much alcohol in the short-term or on a single occasion (often referred to as binge drinking or heavy drinking). If you drink too much alcohol on a single occasion, you may experience these effects:

items: Impaired memory or loss of memory
Stupor (when someone is not alert or responsive, and has difficulty getting up or moving around)
Respiratory arrest (when someone stops breathing or has trouble breathing)
